description:

additional_info.subject: 0442257 - ID0442257-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2/S1 313508370012] Issue with FC20 circuit breaker CRM:00314000205
additional_info.body:
Buon pomeriggio Valerio,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0442257
. This ticket refers to the charger
Y2/S1 313508370012 in Assisi, and it was mistakenly closed on Friday, as a wrong duplicated ticket was indicated. Therefore, I re-opened the ticket, I will share the results with you and I will assign it to you.
On 08.08.2025, I supported Matteo onsite for the troubleshooting of the charger. FC20 was tripping.
We measured that FC20 had no issue, as it is not tripping if the main fan is disconnected, and that the 230AC supply arrives correctly to connector XD7.1B. The issue stands in the Main fan, which needs to be replaced. Here is the MLFB of the component:
